content:
anya: heads-up: new int8 encoder landed in canary pool — seeing a small but consistent bump in funcall parse errors for structured tool outputs
mike: how small? numbers?
anya: ~1.9% parse_fail on canary traffic vs 0.15% baseline, concentrated on toolcall suffixes with odd trailing bytes
sam: screenshot of raw tail: 
```
...}
}
```
mike: 0x01 sentinel showing up. odd. runtime shouldn't be emitting that
lia: could be quantization shifting tokenizer splits so streaming chunk boundary includes control byte
anya: reproable locally w/ `scripts/repro/encoder_int8_smoke.sh` — my run yielded 4/250 malformed outputs
deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-25T14:12Z finished to canary-2
mike: immediate mitigation: add lightweight postprocess to strip low control bytes (0x00-0x1F) from toolcall suffix and emit a parse-repair metric tag `repair=strip_ctl`
sam: agree but add telemetry that records which repair was used (strip, wrap-sentinel, json5) so we don't hide patterns
lia: propose experiment: add sentinel wrapper only for tool outputs: prefix `<<<RDW_JSON>>>` and suffix `<<<END>>>` so parser can ignore streaming noise between wrappers
anya: wrapper + sanitizer rolled to 12% canary at 14:30 — parse_fail on wrapped cohort dropped to 0.3%
sam: plan for root cause: run token-diff between fp16 decode and int8 decode for failing prompts, find first differing token and inspect pre-tokenization bytes. I'll spin up a micro-bisect over per-channel scale vs global scale params
mike: add covariates: kvprefix length, streaming-chunk-size, temperature. include these in the sweep matrix
lia: also adding strict-schema probe: schema = {tool:string, args:{q:string, loc:string}}. record `schema_failure_type` (truncated, nonjson, controlchar, extra_fields)
anya: logged RED-ML-1283 with samples + s3://canaries/encoder_int8/1719007777/fails.jsonl
deploy-bot: ticket RED-ML-1283 created by anya
mike: owners?
anya: i'll own mitigation and follow-up. sam owns quant sweep. lia owns schema telemetry + dashboard tiles
sam: ETA for first sweep pass: 24h
lia: will add dashboard alert if parse_fail_rate > 1% sustained 10m for any pool
anya: temporary mitigation: keep wrapper+sanitizer in canary until sweep finds safe quant config. If we find clear config, plan slow rollout to dedicated
mike: keep root-cause actions separate from mitigation. do not ship wrapper to prod without sign-off
lia: PR incoming for telemetry and parser changes
anya: thanks all — next check-in tomorrow morning or earlier if spike reappears :thumbsup:
